steps.what: Monitor construction activities and relevant site conditions against environmental requirements
Evaluate environmental concerns and communicate required action within inspection authority

tasks.design: Retain field observation and the inspector's evaluation of environmental conditions. Current permit material in {DOCS} supports inspection; energy-usage analytics from the digest do not establish that site compliance can be monitored automatically.
tasks.previous_blocker: Environmental compliance depends on actual site conditions and applicable permit scope.
tasks.enabler_now: No relevant validated replacement for field observation is supplied.
tasks.still_hard: Changing work, ambiguous observations and requirements requiring specialist interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise unexpected site conditions and communicate proportionate action.
tasks.altitude: Inspection time and statutory or contractual authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Coordinate responses to environmental site concerns

evidence.claim: Site environmental observation and contextual compliance evaluation remain inspector work; the digest's energy tools do not demonstrate this monitoring capability.

assumptions: Boundary is environmental site monitoring and immediate communication, excluding separate inspection reports, remediation and project design review. Overlapping observations are owned once in the team roll-up.

Inspector produces site observations in s1, retaining all observation time. Permit authority produces existing permit conditions; no structured violation flag, complete sensor coverage or automatic safe-status input is assumed.
Test existing permit access and native inspection functions first. Unchanged inspection adds no incremental system upkeep. National environmental and enforcement rules must be established locally.
research_questions: Which environmental conditions can only be established through site observation or specialist measurement?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=70+30=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Field observation, evaluation and direct communication retain full time; no report-writing baseline is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Examine project details and establish applicable environmental requirements
Evaluate project adherence to environmental regulations and resolve material uncertainties

tasks.design: Keep the inspector responsible for applying environmental requirements to project evidence in {DOCS}. Versioned plans and permits support the review, but no complete machine-readable compliance rule set or automated finding is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Project-specific environmental requirements cannot be reduced to an unverified generic checklist.
tasks.enabler_now: No digest capability establishes automatic project environmental compliance evaluation.
tasks.still_hard: Applicability, conflicting documents and incomplete environmental evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise missing evidence and distinguish a documented fact from a compliance conclusion.
tasks.altitude: Project evaluation and authority remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Trace findings to plan revisions and applicable permit requirements

evidence.claim: Environmental project evaluation requires contextual applicability and evidence review; energy-label and billing tools do not establish this broader compliance capability.

assumptions: Boundary is project-detail evaluation, excluding field monitoring, design production and formal enforcement. Shared permit reading across tasks must be assigned once rather than added twice.

Project designer and permit authority supply existing versioned plans and conditions; inspector establishes applicability and gaps in s1 with full time retained. No structured compliance code or automatic pass/fail producer is assumed.
Test native versioned document access first. No changed workflow adds upkeep. Applicable national rules and approval routes are customer facts, not inferred from energy-audit examples.
research_questions: Which recurrent checks have explicit verified rules and source fields suitable for a separate bounded pilot?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+60=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Evidence examination and project-specific compliance judgement retain time; existing document retrieval earns no new saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Environmental inspection and project evaluation retain their current human effort and decision boundaries.
reach: Coordinate traceable environmental concerns with construction supervisors
role.ambitious_version: An inspector who makes environmental findings traceable to actual observations and current project evidence, without overstating automatic compliance coverage.
